articles.title_en: When Product Markets Become Collective Traps: The Case of Social Media
articles.title_cn: 当产品市场成为集体陷阱：社交媒体案例
articles.abstract_en: Individuals might experience negative utility from not consuming a popular product. With such externalities to nonusers, standard consumer surplus measures, which take aggregate consumption as given, fail to appropriately capture consumer welfare. We propose an approach to account for these externalities and apply it to estimate consumer welfare from two social media platforms: TikTok and Instagram. Incentivized experiments with college students indicate positive welfare based on the standard measure but negative welfare when accounting for these nonuser externalities. Our findings highlight the existence of product market traps, where active users of a platform prefer it not to exist.
articles.abstract_cn: 个人可能会因不消费流行产品而体验到负面效用。由于对非用户的这种外部性，以总消费为给定的标准消费者剩余衡量标准无法适当地反映消费者福利。我们提出了一种方法来解释这些外部性，并将其应用于估计来自 二 社交媒体平台（TikTok 和 Instagram）的消费者福利。对大学生的激励实验表明，基于标准衡量标准的福利是正的，但考虑到这些非使用者外部性时，福利是负的。我们的研究结果强调了产品市​​场陷阱的存在，平台的活跃用户宁愿它不存在。

articles.title_en: Supply, Demand, Institutions, and Firms: A Theory of Labor Market Sorting and the Wage Distribution
articles.title_cn: 供给、需求、机构和企业：劳动力市场分类和工资分配理论
articles.abstract_en: This paper examines how workforce composition, labor demand, and minimum wage jointly determine wages through their effects on worker-task assignments, firm wage premiums, and firm-worker sorting. Using an estimated model of monopsonistic local labor markets, it finds that minimum wage hikes and labor demand shocks drove the decline in Brazilian wage inequality from 1998 to 2012. While rising educational attainment compressed skill premiums within firms, it also reallocated skilled workers to high-wage firms, limiting that shock's effect on inequality. The analysis highlights interactions among exogenous factors, showing that concurrent supply and demand changes attenuated minimum wage impacts.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文研究了劳动力构成、劳动力需求和最低工资如何通过其对工人任务分配、企业工资溢价和企业工人分类的影响来共同决定工资。使用垄断当地劳动力市场的估计模型发现，最低工资上涨和劳动力需求冲击推动巴西工资不平等从 1998 下降到 2012。虽然教育程度的提高压缩了企业内部的技能溢价，但它也将技术工人重新分配到高工资企业，限制了这种冲击对不平等的影响。该分析强调了外生因素之间的相互作用，表明同时发生的供需变化减弱了最低工资的影响。

articles.title_en: Downward Rigidity in the Wage for New Hires
articles.abstract_en: Wage rigidity is an important explanation for unemployment fluctuations. In benchmark models wages for new hires are key, but there is limited evidence on this margin. We use wages posted on vacancies, with job and establishment information, to measure the wage for new hires. We show that our measure of the wage for new hires is rigid downward and flexible upward, in two steps. First, wages change infrequently at the job level, and fall especially rarely. Second, wages do not respond to rises in unemployment, but respond strongly to falls in unemployment. Job information is crucial for detecting downward rigidity.
articles.abstract_cn: 工资刚性是失业波动的一个重要解释。在基准模型中，新员工的工资是关键，但关于这一点的证据有限。我们使用空缺职位上公布的工资以及职位和机构信息来衡量新员工的工资。我们表明，我们对新员工工资的衡量是严格向下和灵活向上的，以 二 为步长。 第一，工作层面的工资变化很少，尤其很少下降。 第二，工资不会对失业率的上升做出反应，但会对失业率的下降做出强烈的反应。工作信息对于检测向下刚性至关重要。

articles.title_cn: 财务建议中的性别差异
articles.abstract_en: Based on data gathered from 27,000 real-world meetings between financial advisors and clients of a large German bank, we show that advisors offer more self-serving advice to women, while men are more likely to receive sales fee rebates and less likely to be recommended expensive in-house multi-asset (IHMA) funds. Additional client and advisor surveys provide evidence consistent with statistical discrimination based on gender as a proxy for client financial sophistication, with female clients exhibiting lower financial literacy, confidence, and price sensitivity. Moreover, female advisors report less confidence in their own professional skills and engage in less discrimination than male colleagues.
articles.abstract_cn: 根据 27,000 财务顾问与德国一家大型银行客户之间的真实会议收集的数据，我们发现顾问向女性提供更多自私的建议，而男性更有可能获得销售费用回扣，并且不太可能被推荐昂贵的内部多资产 (IHMA) 基金。其他客户和顾问调查提供的证据与基于性别的统计歧视相一致，作为客户财务成熟度的代表，女性客户表现出较低的金融知识、信心和价格敏感性。此外，与男性同事相比，女性顾问对自己的专业技能缺乏信心，受到的歧视也较少。

articles.title_en: A Goldilocks Theory of Fiscal Deficits
articles.title_cn: 财政赤字的金发姑娘理论
articles.abstract_en: We develop a tractable framework for deficit and debt dynamics. A "free lunch" fiscal deficit—one that raises spending without higher future taxes—is sustainable without zero lower bound (ZLB) only when R < G − φ, where φ is the sensitivity of the interest rate to the debt level. With the ZLB, both high and low deficits can increase debt, as the latter weaken demand and reduce nominal growth at the ZLB. A rise in income inequality expands fiscal space outside the ZLB, but contracts it at the ZLB. Calibrating the model, we find little space for "free lunch" policies for the United States in 2019, but significant space for Japan.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们为赤字和债务动态制定了一个易于处理的框架。 “免费午餐”财政赤字（一 可以在未来不增加税收的情况下提高支出）只有在 R < G − φ（其中 φ 是利率对债务水平的敏感性）时才可以在没有 零 下限 (ZLB) 的情况下持续。对于ZLB，高赤字和低赤字都会增加债务，因为后者会削弱需求并降低ZLB的名义增长。收入不平等的加剧扩大了零利率下限以外的财政空间，但缩小了零利率下限的财政空间。校准模型后，我们发现 2019 中美国的“免费午餐”政策空间很小，但日本的空间很大。

articles.title_en: Strategic Voting in Two-Party Legislative Elections
articles.title_cn: 二 党立法选举中的战略投票
articles.abstract_en: I study multidistrict legislative elections with two parties and two binary dimensions of policy. Strategic voters focus on the dimension where their district is most likely to be pivotal in the legislature. Anticipating this, candidates select different policies than they would in single-district elections. The final policy is (i) uniquely pinned down by voter preferences, (ii) preferred by a majority of districts on each dimension, and (iii) a Condorcet winner if one exists. These properties are not guaranteed in single-district elections.
articles.abstract_cn: 我研究了 二 政党的多区立法选举和 二 政策的二元维度。战略选民关注的是他们的选区最有可能在立法机构中发挥关键作用的方面。预见到这一点，候选人选择了与单区选举不同的政策。最终政策是 (i) 由选民偏好唯一确定的，(ii) 在每个维度上得到大多数选区的偏好，以及 (iii) 如果 一 存在，则成为孔多塞获胜者。这些属性在单区选举中得不到保证。

articles.title_en: Firm Responses and Wage Effects of Foreign Demand Shocks with Fixed Labor Costs and Monopsony
articles.title_cn: 固定劳动力成本和垄断下外国需求冲击的企业反应和工资影响
articles.abstract_en: We quantify the firm responses and real wage effects of foreign demand shocks. We use Belgian microdata to construct firm-specific measures of demand shocks, which capture that firms pass on foreign demand shocks to domestic suppliers. Our estimates of firm responses to these shocks suggest that firms face upward-sloping labor supply curves and have sizable fixed labor costs. We specify a general equilibrium model with these features to quantify the aggregate effects of simulated tariff shocks on wages. We find that ignoring fixed labor costs substantially underestimates aggregate effects on wages, whereas incorporating upward-sloping labor supply appears less consequential.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们量化了外国需求冲击的企业反应和实际工资影响。我们使用比利时的微观数据来构建特定于企业的需求冲击指标，其中捕捉到企业将外国需求冲击传递给国内供应商的情况。我们对企业对这些冲击的反应的估计表明，企业面临着向上倾斜的劳动力供给曲线，并且拥有相当大的固定劳动力成本。我们指定具有这些特征的一般均衡模型来量化模拟关税冲击对工资的总体影响。我们发现，忽略固定劳动力成本大大低估了对工资的总体影响，而纳入向上倾斜的劳动力供应似乎不太重要。

articles.title_en: First-Generation Elite: The Role of School Social Networks
articles.title_cn: 第一-一代精英：学校社交网络的作用
articles.abstract_en: High school students from non-elite backgrounds are less likely to have peers with elite-educated parents than their elite counterparts. This difference in social capital is a key driver of the high intergenerational persistence in elite education. We identify a positive elite peer effect on enrollment in elite programs and labor market earnings, then disentangle underlying mechanisms. Exploiting a lottery in assessment, a causal mediation analysis shows the overall positive peer effect reflects a positive effect on application behavior (conditional on GPA). When considering income mobility, we find that further mixing between high school elite and non-elite students could improve mobility.
articles.abstract_cn: 来自非精英背景的高中生与精英学生相比，其同龄人父母受过精英教育的可能性较小。这种社会资本的差异是精英教育代际间高度坚持的关键驱动力。我们确定了精英同伴对精英项目入学率和劳动力市场收入的积极影响，然后理清了潜在的机制。利用评估中的抽签方式，因果中介分析表明，整体积极的同伴效应反映了对申请行为的积极影响（以 GPA 为条件）。在考虑收入流动性时，我们发现高中精英学生和非精英学生之间的进一步混合可以改善流动性。

articles.title_en: Incentive Complexity, Bounded Rationality, and Effort Provision
articles.title_cn: 激励复杂性、有限理性和努力提供
articles.abstract_en: Using field and laboratory experiments, we demonstrate that the complexity of incentive schemes and worker bounded rationality can affect effort provision. This is because some attributes of the incentives become opaque; that is, workers do not take them into account. In our setting, workers overprovide effort relative to a fully rational benchmark, improving efficiency. We identify contract features, and facets of worker cognitive ability, that matter for opacity. We find that even relatively small degrees of opacity can cause large shifts in behavior. Our results illustrate important implications of complexity and bounded rationality for designing and regulating workplace incentive contracts.
articles.abstract_cn: 通过现场和实验室实验，我们证明了激励计划的复杂性和工人有限理性会影响努力的提供。这是因为激励措施的某些属性变得不透明；也就是说，工人们没有考虑到它们。在我们的环境中，相对于完全理性的基准，员工付出了过多的努力，从而提高了效率。我们确定了对不透明性很重要的合同特征和工人认知能力的各个方面。我们发现，即使是相对较小程度的不透明度也会导致行为的巨大转变。我们的结果说明了复杂性和有限理性对于设计和监管工作场所激励合同的重要影响。

articles.title_en: Changing Income Risk across the US Skill Distribution: Evidence from a Generalized Kalman Filter
articles.title_cn: 美国技能分布中收入风险的变化：来自广义卡尔曼滤波器的证据
articles.abstract_en: For whom has earnings risk changed, and why? We answer these questions by combining the Kalman filter and EM algorithm to estimate persistent and temporary earnings for every individual at every point in time. We apply our method to administrative earnings linked with survey data. We show that since the 1980s, persistent earnings risk rose by 12.5 percent for both employed and unemployed workers and the scarring effects of unemployment doubled. At the same time, temporary earnings risk declined. Using education and occupation codes, we show that rising persistent earnings risk is concentrated among high-skill workers and related to technology adoption.
articles.abstract_cn: 谁的盈利风险发生了变化，为什么？我们通过结合卡尔曼滤波器和 EM 算法来回答这些问题，以估计每个人在每个时间点的持续和临时收入。我们将我们的方法应用于与调查数据相关的行政收入。我们发现，自 1980 以来，就业和失业工人的持续收入风险均上升了 12.5%，失业的创伤效应加倍。与此同时，暂时盈利风险下降。根据教育和职业规范，我们发现持续上升的收入风险集中在高技能工人中，并且与技术采用有关。

articles.title_en: An Equilibrium Analysis of the Effects of Neighborhood-Based Interventions on Children
articles.title_cn: 基于社区的干预措施对儿童影响的均衡分析
articles.abstract_en: This paper studies housing vouchers and urban redevelopment programs by incorporating neighborhood effects into a general equilibrium overlapping-generations model with endogenous location choice and child development. We calibrate the model using US data and estimate impacts of large-scale implementations of rental voucher and place-based subsidy policies. Our core finding is that vouchers generate long-run welfare gains by reducing inequality and generating skill improvements that offset higher taxation and other GE effects. Although vouchers lead to larger welfare gains on average, we find that place-based subsidies may be preferable in cities with constrained housing supply.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文通过将邻里效应纳入具有内生位置选择和儿童发展的一般均衡重叠代模型中，研究住房券和城市重建计划。我们使用美国数据校准模型，并估计大规模实施租赁券和地方补贴政策的影响。我们的核心发现是，代金券通过减少不平等和提高技能来抵消更高的税收和其他通用电气效应，从而产生长期福利收益。尽管代金券平均带来更大的福利收益，但我们发现，在住房供应有限的城市，基于地方的补贴可能更可取。

articles.title_cn: 具有混合厌恶偏好的分配机制
articles.abstract_en: Consider an economy with equal amounts of N types of goods, to be allocated to agents with strict quasi-convex preferences over lotteries. We show that ex ante, all Pareto-efficient allocations give almost all agents lotteries over at most two outcomes. Our results provide a simple criterion showing that many popular allocation mechanisms are ex ante inefficient. For the case of identical preferences, we establish existence of an efficient solution where all lotteries used are equally attractive. Assuming the reduction axiom, social welfare deteriorates by first randomizing over these binary lotteries. Efficient ex ante equality is achieved if agents satisfy the compound-independence axiom.
articles.abstract_cn: 考虑一个具有等量 N 种商品的经济体，这些商品被分配给对彩票具有严格准凸偏好的代理。我们事前表明，所有帕累托有效分配都为几乎所有代理提供最多 二 结果的彩票。我们的结果提供了一个简单的标准，表明许多流行的分配机制事前效率低下。对于相同偏好的情况，我们建立了一种有效的解决方案，其中使用的所有彩票都具有同等的吸引力。假设减少公理，社会福利会因 第一 对这些二元彩票进行随机化而恶化。如果主体满足复合独立公理，则可以实现有效的事前平等。
